nodes.name: auto_trader_loop.go
nodes.summary: The main auto-trading cycle: assembles the full kernel.Context (positions, account, candidate coins, market data, session stats), resolves the prompt variant (futures vs crypto), runs the AI decision through the strategy engine, records Prometheus telemetry, and sorts/executes the resulting decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: resolvePromptVariant implements the Strategy Studio Mode dropdown: saved prompt_variant wins, otherwise venue rules (ninjatrader→futures) keep the fallback byte-identical to prior behavior.

nodes.name: resolvePromptVariant
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective prompt variant: saved strategy value wins, else venue-rule fallback (ninjatrader→futures, otherwise balanced).

nodes.name: runCycle
nodes.summary: Runs one full trading cycle: build context, get the AI decision via kernel.GetFullDecisionWithStrategy, record latency/decision metrics, sort and execute decisions, persist records.

nodes.name: buildTradingContext
nodes.summary: Assembles the kernel.Context: open positions, account info, candidate coins, market data, CME session stats and recent orders.

nodes.name: sortDecisionsByPriority
nodes.summary: Orders AI decisions so closes and risk-reducing actions execute before new opens.

nodes.name: checkClaw402Balance
nodes.summary: Checks the Claw402 pay-per-use balance and warns or blocks when runway is low.

nodes.name: auto_trader_orders.go
nodes.summary: Decision execution layer: converts USD notionals to CME contract counts, performs reconcile-before-open verification for NinjaTrader, and implements the open/close long/short executors with leverage setup and fill-confirmed order recording.

nodes.name: futuresOrderQuantity
nodes.summary: Converts a USD notional into a CME contract count using the symbol's point value, clamped by max contracts.

nodes.name: executeDecisionWithRecord
nodes.summary: Routes an AI decision to the matching open/close executor and links the action record.

nodes.name: ntHeldPosition
nodes.summary: Queries the NinjaTrader broker for the currently held position on a symbol.

nodes.name: reconcileBeforeOpenNT
nodes.summary: Pre-open reconcile for NT8: verifies broker-side position state before opening to avoid phantom position stacking.

nodes.name: executeOpenLongWithRecord
nodes.summary: Opens a long with leverage/margin setup, CME contract sizing for futures symbols, and fill-confirmed order recording.

nodes.name: executeOpenShortWithRecord
nodes.summary: Opens a short with leverage/margin setup, CME contract sizing for futures symbols, and fill-confirmed order recording.

nodes.name: executeCloseLongWithRecord
nodes.summary: Closes a long position and records the fill-confirmed close.

nodes.name: executeCloseShortWithRecord
nodes.summary: Closes a short position and records the fill-confirmed close.

nodes.name: auto_trader_grid.go
nodes.summary: Grid strategy core: the mutex-guarded GridState, protective checks (breakout, max drawdown, daily loss limit, emergency exit), grid initialization, and the per-cycle orchestration that gets AI grid decisions from the kernel and executes them.

nodes.name: GridState
nodes.summary: In-memory grid strategy state: config, price bounds, spacing, levels, pause/init flags and daily PnL tracking, guarded by a mutex.

nodes.name: GridRiskInfo
nodes.summary: Snapshot of grid risk posture: current/effective/recommended leverage, position usage and liquidation distance.

nodes.name: NewGridState
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty GridState for a grid configuration.

nodes.name: checkBreakout
nodes.summary: Detects price breakout beyond grid bounds by a configured percentage.

nodes.name: checkMaxDrawdown
nodes.summary: Monitors account drawdown against the configured maximum and triggers emergency exit when breached.

nodes.name: checkDailyLossLimit
nodes.summary: Enforces the daily realized-loss limit by pausing the grid when exceeded.

nodes.name: emergencyExit
nodes.summary: Cancels all grid orders, closes positions and pauses the grid with a recorded reason.

nodes.name: handleBreakout
nodes.summary: Responds to a detected breakout (pause or emergency exit) based on configuration.

nodes.name: InitializeGrid
nodes.summary: Initializes grid bounds and levels around the current price and marks the grid ready.

nodes.name: RunGridCycle
nodes.summary: Runs one grid trading cycle: risk checks, state sync, AI grid decisions via the kernel grid engine, and order execution.

nodes.name: buildGridContext
nodes.summary: Builds the kernel.GridContext from live market data and grid state for the AI grid prompt.

nodes.name: executeGridDecision
nodes.summary: Dispatches one grid decision (place/cancel/adjust/pause/resume) to the matching handler.

nodes.name: IsGridStrategy
nodes.summary: Reports whether this trader is configured with the grid_trading strategy type.

nodes.name: saveGridDecisionRecord
nodes.summary: Persists the grid AI decision as a decision record for dashboard display.

nodes.name: auto_trader_grid_levels.go
nodes.summary: Grid level construction and maintenance: ATR-based or default bound calculation, evenly spaced level initialization, direction-aware buy/sell assignment, skew detection and automatic grid re-centering, each with locked variants for callers already holding the grid mutex.

nodes.name: calculateATRBounds
nodes.summary: Derives grid upper/lower bounds from ATR volatility around the current price.

nodes.name: initializeGridLevels
nodes.summary: Creates evenly spaced grid levels between bounds with per-level side and quantity.

nodes.name: applyGridDirection
nodes.summary: Assigns/filters buy and sell levels according to the configured grid direction (long/short/neutral).

nodes.name: checkGridSkew
nodes.summary: Detects when price drifts toward one edge of the grid, signalling that re-centering is needed.

nodes.name: autoAdjustGrid
nodes.summary: Re-centers and rebuilds the grid around the current price when skew or drift thresholds are hit.

nodes.name: calculateATRBoundsLocked
nodes.summary: Mutex-free variant of calculateATRBounds for callers already holding the grid lock.

nodes.name: initializeGridLevelsLocked
nodes.summary: Mutex-free variant of initializeGridLevels for callers already holding the grid lock.

nodes.name: applyGridDirectionLocked
nodes.summary: Mutex-free variant of applyGridDirection for callers already holding the grid lock.

nodes.name: auto_trader_grid_orders.go
nodes.summary: Grid order execution: places grid limit orders behind a total-position-value limit, cancels single/all grid orders, pause/resume controls, exchange-state synchronization and per-position stop-loss enforcement.

nodes.name: checkTotalPositionLimit
nodes.summary: Blocks new grid orders that would push total position value beyond the configured limit.

nodes.name: placeGridLimitOrder
nodes.summary: Places a grid limit order (buy/sell) with position-limit checks, records it and updates the level state.

nodes.name: cancelGridOrder
nodes.summary: Cancels a single grid order and clears its level assignment.

nodes.name: cancelAllGridOrders
nodes.summary: Cancels all outstanding grid orders.

nodes.name: pauseGrid
nodes.summary: Pauses the grid with a reason, halting new order placement.

nodes.name: adjustGrid
nodes.summary: Applies an AI-requested grid adjustment and rebuilds orders.

nodes.name: syncGridState
nodes.summary: Reconciles in-memory grid level/order state against exchange open orders and positions.

nodes.name: closeAllPositions
nodes.summary: Market-closes all grid positions.

nodes.name: checkAndExecuteStopLoss
nodes.summary: Evaluates stop-loss conditions per position and executes protective closes.

nodes.name: grid_regime.go
nodes.summary: Market-regime logic for grid trading: classifies regime level from Bollinger band width and ATR14 percentage, applies regime-based leverage and position limits, detects and confirms grid-box breakouts, and adjusts grid direction on breakout or recovery.

nodes.name: BreakoutState
nodes.summary: Tracks an in-progress grid-box breakout: severity level, direction, consecutive confirmation count, and start time.

nodes.name: classifyRegimeLevel
nodes.summary: Maps Bollinger band width percentage and ATR14 percentage into a narrow/normal/wide market regime level.

nodes.name: getRegimeLeverageLimit
nodes.summary: Returns the leverage cap for a regime level, honoring per-level overrides from the grid config.

nodes.name: getRegimePositionLimit
nodes.summary: Returns the maximum position ratio for a regime level, honoring per-level overrides from the grid config.

nodes.name: detectBoxBreakout
nodes.summary: Detects whether price has broken above or below the grid box bounds and grades the breakout severity.

nodes.name: confirmBreakout
nodes.summary: Requires consecutive same-direction confirmations before a breakout is considered real, updating BreakoutState.

nodes.name: getBreakoutAction
nodes.summary: Maps a confirmed breakout severity level to the grid action to take.

nodes.name: determineGridDirection
nodes.summary: Chooses the grid trading direction from price position within the box and any confirmed breakout level and direction.

nodes.name: determineRecoveryDirection
nodes.summary: Picks the grid direction to resume when price re-enters the box after a breakout.

nodes.name: getBreakoutActionWithDirection
nodes.summary: Breakout action selection that also accounts for whether automatic direction adjustment is enabled.
